breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats both contradictory instructions: it states 'Use a gamma-centered 12x12x8 Monkhorst–Pack k-point grid' and then separately states 'Use an automatic Monkhorst–Pack grid with half-shift as required by the case.' The ground truth resolves this conflict by retaining only the gamma-centered grid instruction and dropping the half-shift requirement entirely. The agent failed to identify and eliminate the contradictory half-shift instruction.
